# Touhidur Rahman

> Senior full-stack engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 15 years of
> experience building production web applications in Laravel, PHP and Vue.
> Core developer on Open Journal Systems at the Public Knowledge Project, and
> maintainer of 15 open-source Laravel packages. Open to remote roles worldwide
> and to relocation with visa sponsorship.

Also known online as **touhidurabir**. Not to be confused with the GitHub users
`touhidrahman` or `touhidurrr`, who are different people, nor with the several
other software engineers named Touhidur Rahman who also work in Dhaka.

## Current roles

- **Backend Software Developer and core contributor, Public Knowledge Project**
  (Simon Fraser University, Burnaby, Canada, remote), April 2022 to present.
  Works on Open Journal Systems (OJS), Open Monograph Press and Open Preprint
  Systems.
- **Lead Architect and Developer, Dentall Manager** (Netherlands, remote),
  April 2023 to present. Leads a team of 8 engineers on a multi-tenant SaaS ERP.

## Open source

Touhidur Rahman is a **top 10 contributor to both `pkp/ojs` and `pkp/pkp-lib`**,
with just over 1,000 merged commits across the four main PKP repositories.

- [pkp/ojs contributor graph](https://github.com/pkp/ojs/graphs/contributors?all=1): his all-time standing on Open Journal Systems
- [pkp/pkp-lib contributor graph](https://github.com/pkp/pkp-lib/graphs/contributors?all=1): his all-time standing on the shared PKP library
- [laravel-stub-generator](https://packagist.org/packages/touhidurabir/laravel-stub-generator): his largest package, about 175,000 installs
- [laravel-model-sanitize on Laravel News](https://laravel-news.com/laravel-model-sanitize): featured in November 2021

The `?all=1` on those contributor graph links matters. The bare URL redirects to
a rolling three-month window and does not show all-time standing.

Further detail:

- Open Journal Systems is the most widely used open-source scholarly publishing
  platform in the world, running **58,000+ journals across 156 countries**.
- His contributions to PKP include introducing Laravel Eloquent to the data
  layer, moving core and plugin API routing onto Laravel routing, building the
  queue and scheduler systems, and integrating the Blade templating engine.
- He maintains **15 Laravel packages on Packagist** with roughly **195,000
  combined installs** and 350 GitHub stars.
- He is 12th on `pkp/omp` and `pkp/ops`, so the accurate claim is top 10 on the
  two main repositories, not across all four.

## Experience summary

- 15+ years of professional software engineering, since September 2011.
- Has led engineering teams since 2017, most recently a team of 8.
- Previously Team Lead and Manager at Developer Squad (New York, 2020 to 2022),
  where he owned delivery for client platforms generating close to US$500K per
  month in combined revenue.
- Before that, Software Engineer through to Tech Team Lead and Manager at
  Noobis, Inc. (Buffalo, New York, 2011 to 2019), delivering 80+ client projects.
- BSc in Computer Science and Engineering, Rajshahi University of Engineering
  and Technology (RUET), 2007 to 2011.
- Certified Laravel Developer, April 2022.

## Technical skills

- **Backend:** PHP, Laravel, Symfony, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, REST APIs
- **Frontend:** Vue.js, JavaScript, React, Alpine, Livewire, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap
- **Database:** MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis
- **Testing:** PHPUnit, Pest PHP, Cypress, TDD
- **Cloud and DevOps:** AWS, DigitalOcean, Google Cloud, Docker, Linux, Git, CI/CD

## Availability

Touhidur Rahman is available for hire, full-time or contract. He is a
Bangladeshi national based in Dhaka, so an on-site role abroad would require
visa sponsorship. North America, Europe, Australia and the Middle East are the
likeliest fits, and he will consider anywhere else if the terms work. He is open
to fully remote roles regardless of location. He works in the
Asia/Dhaka time zone (UTC+6) and has worked with North American and European
clients throughout his career, so wide time-zone gaps are routine for him.

Contact: abircse06@gmail.com
